name: codex_oracle
description: Node-free Codex Oracle-style second-opinion plugin implemented in Go.

interface.shortDescription: Ask a ChatGPT Pro browser session for a second opinion from Codex.
interface.longDescription: codex_oracle adapts the useful Oracle MCP/browser workflow into a Node-free Codex plugin surface. It exposes consult dry-runs, session lookup, consult_prepare and consult_finalize for Chrome-assisted handoff through the external @Chrome companion plugin, durable running/completed/failed session metadata, handoff digest/nonce/privacy checks, and text/ZIP context bundle primitives. Preferred live use is the Chrome-assisted path with the user's ordinary signed-in Chrome session; private-profile direct CDP is legacy diagnostic fallback only. Browser mode does not require OPENAI_API_KEY forwarding.
defaultPrompt: Ask codex_oracle for a second-opinion review.
Prepare a ChatGPT Pro handoff with current context.
Review this plan through GPT Web with GPT-5.6 Sol and Pro.
